name: dropputt-mobile
description: Android shells (Capacitor) for the customer, vendor and rider apps. The web code lives in ../frontend.

scripts.sync:customer: npm run web:customer && cd customer && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:vendor: npm run web:vendor && cd vendor && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:rider: npm run web:rider && cd rider && npx cap sync android
scripts.open:customer: cd customer && npx cap open android
scripts.open:vendor: cd vendor && npx cap open android
scripts.open:rider: cd rider && npx cap open android
